stem: Meena finds a clear drop of pond water during her science class in Pune. She wants to observe the tiny organisms living in it. Which tool should she use to see them clearly?

options.text: Her unaided eyes, since the water is clear
A microscope, because the organisms are too small to see with the unaided eye
A flat glass windowpane held above the drop
A plane mirror reflecting sunlight onto the drop

teacher.key_rationale: Microorganisms in pond water are far below the size visible to the unaided eye; only a microscope (or suitable magnifying tool) makes them observable. Flat glass and mirrors do not magnify, and clear water does not make the organisms visible.
